title: Absence of false output bits
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $y$ be a bit string, and let $T$ be a natural number. The output after $T$ steps contains no false bit if and only if, at every time $t<T$, the transition prescribed by the snapshot of the run at time $t$ does not emit a false bit.
replaced: For every machine, input $y$, and horizon $T$, the append-only output after $T$ steps contains no false bit exactly when no snapshot before time $T$ emits the bit false; the equivalence is an exact word statement with no halting assumption.
